The new Frieren figure recreates the anime scene of her crying and throwing a tantrum for three days and three nights.

A lot of Chrono Trigger merchandise is on the way in 2027 and includes character items like Frog and Robo plush toys.

Anipex is now in charge of the Fate/Extra Record remake and opened up a new website and social media account for the game.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword is a good action game that sets a solid foundation for the series, but its combat needs more offensive options.
